senses.gloss: the shepherd’s assistantthat gathers the scattered flock.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 56b:6">B. Kam. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>מסרו לרועה לכַרְזִילֵיה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>לב׳</he>, corr. acc.) ‘he surrendered it to the shepherd’ (in Mish.) means to his assistant.

senses.gloss: he who calls to, and leads in prayer.—Pl. כַּרְזִילִין.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 1:8">Targ. Cant. I, 8</cite> <cite ref="K01141"><he>כַּרְזִילָהָא</he></cite> (not <cite ref="B00002"><he>בַּ׳</he></cite>, v. ed. Lag. II, p. XIV) her (the congregation’s) leaders.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 10:10">Targ. Koh. X, 10</cite>.
